question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words.**

Having a sharply strong taste or smell
solution:
The correct answer is **"Pungent."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The word **"pungent"** typically describes something having a sharp, strong taste or smell that is often intense or penetrating. ((गंध) बहुत तीखी)
 
• It can refer to flavors or odors that are sharp, spicy, biting, or acrid.
 
 
• **Example**: *The cheese had a **pungent**__ flavor that lingered on the palate.*
 
 
 
• So, having a sharply strong taste or smell is called **"Pungent."**
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.**
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

• **Alchemy: **a form of chemistry in the Middle Ages which involved trying to discover how to change ordinary metals into gold. (प्राचीनकालिक रसायनशास्‍त्र जिसमें साधारण धातुओं को सोने में बदलने की विधि की खोज की जाती थी)
 
• **Remorse: **a feeling of sadness because you have done something wrong. (पश्‍चात्ताप (ग़लती करने का दुख), ग्‍लानि, अनुताप)
